articles.title: More on the pending oversight hearings: State of Crypto
articles.summary: New letters show the widening range of Congressional committees that will be probing the presidential administration — and the crypto collateral that may be swept up.

articles.title: Bitcoin's quantum security challenge extends to bridges, custodians and millions of coins
articles.summary: Quantum computers can’t break Bitcoin network’s security yet, but Leo Fan warns that upgrading it and moving funds could take longer than expected.

articles.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $60,000 after $1.8 billion crypto liquidation wave
articles.summary: The selloff wiped out $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto positions, mostly from bullish bets on rising prices.
